title: Cunard Line Limited v Champion Travel, Inc. (cunardcruise.com)
text:
P.O.
BOX 50191

MINNEAPOLIS,
MINNESOTA 55405 USA

Cunard Line Limited

6100 Blue Lagoon Drive

Suite 400

Miami, FL 33126

COMPLAINANT

Vs.

Champion Travel, Inc.

POB 386

Riverside, IL 60546

RESPONDENT

DECISION

Forum File No.: FA0001000092053

The above matter came on for an administrative hearing on March 7,
2000 before the undersigned on the Complaint of Cunard Line Limited, hereafter
"Complainant", against Champion Travel, Inc., hereafter "Respondent".
Complainant was represented by Jeffery R. Cohen, 1745 Jefferson Davis
Highway, Suite 612, Arlington, VA 22202. Respondent was represented by
Anne C. Keys, 401 North Michigan Avenue, Suite 1900, Chicago, IL 60611.

Upon the written submitted record, the following DECISION
is made:

PROCEDURAL FINDINGS

Domain Name: CUNARDCRUISE.COM

Domain Name Registrar: Network Solutions

Domain Name Registrant: Champion Travel, Inc.

Date of Registration: November 17, 1998

Date Complaint Filed: January 19, 2000

Date of Commencement of Administrative Proceeding: January 19, 2000

Date of Response: Respondent filed a timely response on February 25,
2000 after

receiving a 20 day extension

After reviewing the Complaint and determining it to be in administrative
compliance, the National Arbitration Forum (The Forum) forwarded the Complaint
to the Respondent in compliance with Rule 2(a), and the administrative
proceeding was commenced pursuant to Rule 4(c). In compliance with Rule
4(d), The Forum immediately notified Network Solutions, the Internet Corporation
for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN), and the Complainant that the administrative
proceeding had commenced. Respondent filed a response within the time
allowed.

The Respondent registered the domain name with Network Solutions,
the entity that is the Registrar of the domain name. By registering its
domain name with Network Solutions, the Respondent agreed to resolve any
dispute regarding its domain name through ICANN'S Uniform Domain Name
Dispute Resolution Policy.

FINDINGS OF FACT

The Complainant Cunard Lines Limited is a cruise ship company that
has been in business for over 160 years. It has a large number of marks
that are registered with the United States Patent & Trademark Office
that includes CUNARD; CUNARD COUNTESS; CUNARD-CARE; CUNARD LUXURY; CUNARD
CROWN; CUNARD & Design; CUNARD CRUISE MILES; CUNARD. WE MAKE ALL
THE DIFFERENCE; CUNARD ROYAL VIKING & Design; CUNARD QUEEN ELIZABETH
2 & Design; and, CUNARD DYNASY.

The Complainant also has a pending federal trademark application for
the mark CUNARD.COM. and has properly registered the following domain
names with Network Solutions, Inc.: CUNARDLINES.COM, CUNARDLINE.COM
& CUNARD.COM.

The Respondent registered the domain name CUNARDCRUISE.COM on November
17, 1998 but has not yet completed the establishment of the web site.

The Respondent states in its answer that, since before notice of the
dispute, it has used or prepared to use CUNARDCRUISE.COM in connection
with a bona fide offering of goods or services (See Respondents response,
paragraph 15 at page 5).

The Respondent registered the domain name with the intent to market
Complainant's goods and services via an exclusive web site and in exercising
its intent and use of CUNARDCRUISE.COM, Respondent reviewed other competing
web sites and had specific discussions with a web site developer.

The Respondent's use of the domain name CUNARDCRUISE.COM is identical
or confusingly similar to the Complainant’s established trademarks.

The Respondent has no legitimate interests in respect of the domain
name and seeks to profit from its registration of said domain name by
trading upon the goodwill associated with the Cunard name.

The Complainant's prayer for relief requests that the domain name
CUNARDCRUISE.COM be transferred from Respondent to Complainant.

CONCLUSIONS

The undersigned certifies that he has acted independently and has
no known conflict of interest to serve as the Arbitrator in this proceeding.
Having been duly selected and being impartial, the undersigned makes the
following findings and conclusions:

The domain name CUNARDCRUISE.COM, registered by Respondent on November
17, 1998 with Network Solutions, is identical to Complainant's name
and is confusingly similar to a trademark in which the Complainant
has rights, and to which the Respondent has no right or legitimate
interests.

By using the domain name CUNARDCRUISE.COM, the Respondent has and
will intentionally attempt to attract, for commercial gain, Internet
users by creating a likelihood of confusion with the Complainant's
mark as to source, sponsorship, affiliation, or endorsement of the
web site.

DECISION

Based upon the above findings and conclusions, and pursuant to Rule
4(I), it is decided as follows:

THE UNDERSIGNED DIRECTS THAT THE DOMAIN NAME "CUNARDCRUISE.COM"
REGISTERED BY RESPONDENT CHAMPION TRAVEL, INC. BE TRANSFERRED TO COMPLAINANT
CUNARD LINES LIMITED.

Dated: March 8, 2000, by Judge Daniel B. Banks, Jr.(Ret.), Arbitrator.

Honorable Daniel B. Banks, Jr.
